## Summary

- What changed (1-3 bullets)
- Why it was needed

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Breaking change (changes CLI flags or output format)
- [ ] Refactor, docs or tooling only

## Changeset

- [ ] Needs a changeset if it changes what users get; otherwise say why not

## Completeness

- Other places with the same problem: what you looked for and found, or why there are none
- Docs, comments and tests that described the old behavior: what you checked
- Evidence the new test fails without the change, or why it cannot

## Test plan

- [ ] `just ci` passes locally
- [ ] Edge cases covered

Trail: https://entire.com/gh/orin-dx/-/trails/<number>
